NAME:
   rancher get setting - List settings or show one

USAGE:
   rancher get setting [options] [name]

OPTIONS:
   --for condition                   wait for condition, e.g. state=active or condition=Ready (starts the wait)
   --help, -h                        show help
   --selector selector, -l selector  filter a list by Kubernetes label selector, e.g. app=web,tier!=cache (kubectl's -l)
   --timeout timeout                 wait timeout, e.g. 5m (default 120s; starts the wait)
   --wait                            wait for the resource to reach its default wait condition, or --for, before returning

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
